slides.texte_overlay:
things i wish i'd started
doing at 20

saving a little each month

i wish i'd put away a small amount every single month, even when it felt pointless. the habit matters far more than the amount, and time does the rest for you.

reading before bed

i wish i'd swapped my phone for a book every night. ten pages a night is around a dozen books a year, and that quietly changes who you become over the years.

calling my grandparents

i wish i'd called them every week and asked about their lives. their stories are a piece of history you can't find anywhere else, and they don't wait forever.

learning a bit every day

i wish i'd spent 5 minutes a day learning about the world: art, history, science. small daily lessons add up to the kind of mind that makes every conversation easier.
slides.texte_sophia:
learning a bit every day

i wish i'd started earlier, but now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app: art, history, science. small daily lessons add up to a mind that makes conversations easy.

slides.texte_overlay:
moving every day

i wish i'd made daily movement non negotiable, even a short walk. your body in your thirties is built by the habits you keep in your twenties, one day at a time.
